text: Natural language processing, or NLP, is a branch of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. Instead of just reading words, NLP looks at the meaning behind them. One common use is machine translation, where tools like online translators convert text from one language to another. Another important application is sentiment analysis, which determines whether a piece of writing is positive, negative, or neutral—useful for companies checking customer opinions. Chatbots also rely on NLP to answer questions naturally and provide support. While these systems have improved greatly, they still struggle with sarcasm and cultural context, so true language understanding remains a fascinating challenge.
